ios.desc:
At 'Em is your personal daily briefing — a simple, beautiful way to start your day prepared.

Open the app and instantly see everything you need to prepare for the day: today's weather, your schedule, tasks, and free time — all in one glance. No digging through multiple apps. No clutter. Just the essentials.

WHAT YOU'LL SEE EACH MORNING:

Weather at a Glance
Current conditions plus morning and afternoon forecasts, so you know exactly what to expect.

Your Schedule, Simplified  
Today's calendar events pulled together in a clean, easy-to-scan view.

Tasks & Reminders
See what needs to get done without opening another app.

Free Time Finder
Instantly see the gaps in your day — perfect for planning when to exercise, take a break, or get focused work done.

Tomorrow Preview
Set an evening notification to see tomorrow's schedule before bed, so you wake up already knowing your plan.

PRIVACY FIRST
At 'Em accesses your calendar, reminders, and location only to show you your briefing. We never collect, store, or share your data. Everything stays on your device.

Simple. Private. Ready when you are.

Download At 'Em and start your mornings with clarity.
